title: Axon Outpost site list, site assessments, installation schedule and delivery records (Q-865809-009)
summary:
Asks the Police Department, for 2026-01-01 through the search date, for records on the Outpost cameras under Exhibit D (File 26-11633):

- Item 1: any list, spreadsheet, map or other record of installation sites proposed, selected, assessed or approved, citing Statement of Work §3 ("location sites approved by Axon").
- Item 2: any site assessment or site walk report, including those described in SOW §§4.1 and 4.1.2.
- Item 3: any installation schedule, deployment plan, project plan or timeline, from Axon or prepared by the City.
- Item 4: delivery and receiving records for hardware shipped under Q-865809-009 (packing lists, bills of lading, delivery confirmations, City receiving records), noting the quote's estimated 2026-10-15 shipment to 200 Franklin Pkwy.

Documents only, not an email search; an email attachment alone is enough. Cites the Department's release of its Flock camera location spreadsheet under W012201-022326, and asks that any withheld site location be tied to a stated legal authority with the rest released.

policy_promises.tests: Do an approved site list and site assessments exist, and are they produced?

policy_promises.quote: An agency shall justify withholding any record by complying with Section 7922.000.
policy_promises.tests: If Outpost locations are withheld, is each withholding tied to an express exemption, given that the Flock location spreadsheet was released under W012201?

policy_promises.quote: Any reasonably segregable portion of a record shall be available for inspection by any person requesting the record after deletion of the portions that are exempted by law.
policy_promises.tests: Is a partially withheld site list released with only the exempt portions removed?

policy_promises.quote: agency must notify requester within 10 calendar days whether it will produce records
policy_promises.tests: Does the City issue a determination by 2026-11-19?

prior_pra_refs.note: Produced Q-865809-009: 45 Outpost sites (46 cameras) shipping 2026-10-15 to 200 Franklin Pkwy, 14 more shipping 2027-10-15, license from 2026-11-15.

The 2026-11-02 supplemental includes the 2026-08-28 to 09-02 "LPR Site Locations" chain: Axon's ALPR Professional Services Manager sent a Site Selection Template link asking for "Intersection/GPS coordinates, direction of capture, pole ownership/type, and power preference (solar or AC)" and asked whether the sites replace existing cameras, plus the Outpost Site Selection Guide. The completed template was not produced; item 1 covers it.
The Department released its Flock camera location spreadsheet, so camera locations have been treated as disclosable.
Same-day request to Public Works for Outpost encroachment permit applications and permits.

filed_because: Council approved 45 Outpost sites on 2026-10-05 with hardware estimated to ship 2026-10-15 and the license starting 2026-11-15, but no site list or schedule has been published. Axon asked SMPD in early September to fill in a site template so permitting could start early. This request asks for that site list, the site assessments, the installation schedule and proof of delivery as documents, without waiting on an email search.
notes: Filed 2026-11-09 at 11:30 AM; auto-acknowledged the same minute and forwarded to department(s) for processing. Statutory determination due 2026-11-19.
